output.headline: Dental365 is a dental-only buyer: all three of its deals were in the target's own sub-sector and all closed, though it has been inactive since 2018.
output.differentiator: Dental365 has all 3 deals in the target's own sub-sector and none elsewhere, with every deal closed. Only Heartland and Aspen match that completion record; Dental365's $68M median deal is close to the target's size.
output.why_them: Pure dental buyer with a 100% close record

acquirer_overview.title: Dental365 is a dental-only buyer with a short, fully closed record
points: Dental365 is a strategic buyer with 3 deals between 2016 and 2018, all closed, all control deals, all in the target's sub-sector [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Deals ranged from $22M to $73M with a median of $68M; 2 of 3 fall in the comparable size band of $40M-$160M [T:record, K:size_band].
Dental365 has done no deals since 2022. Its profile and revenue were not researched [K:recent, V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Sub-sector focus is the strongest factor behind Dental365's ranking
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; a target margin close to what Dental365 usually buys is a modest factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
Growth was the motive in 2 of 3 Dental365 deals (High Growth), against 41% of all deals in the file; this suits the target's 8.0% growth [M:high_growth, X:target].
Dental365 ranks 8th on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 4.8% across 107 buyers scored; it has no Southeast deal to date [R:rank, T:record].

precedent_activity.title: Dental365's three dental precedents run 14.0x to 16.1x, latest in 2018
points: Crown Dental Care: $73M Strategic Acquisition in the Midwest, 2018, at 14.5x EBITDA, the closest in size to the target [D:MA-2018-0442].
Peak Dental Management: $68M Management Buyout, 2016, at 16.1x, the highest multiple Dental365 has paid [D:MA-2016-0178].
Keystone Oral Health: $22M Leveraged Buyout, 2018, at 14.0x; well below the target's size [D:MA-2018-0011].

valuation_context.title: Target supports upper-quartile pricing; Dental365's history sits just below
points: Comparable range is 11.0x to 15.4x EV/EBITDA, median 13.7x, across 63 deals in the $40M-$160M band [V:comps].
Target margin of 18.0% beats the comps median of 12.4% and exceeds 92% of comps, so the 75th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
Dental365's median paid is 14.5x. Cost synergy headroom is $5M-$9M, but its revenue was not researched, so ability to pay is unconfirmed [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Dormant acquirer
risk_flags.concern: Dental365 has not dealt since 2018, and none since 2022; deals in recent years count slightly against it [K:recent, S:recency].
risk_flags.mitigant: All 3 deals closed, so execution is proven when it does transact [K:closed_share].
risk_flags.reality: Current appetite is unverified and should be tested early on the call [T:record].

risk_flags.title: No Southeast footprint
risk_flags.concern: Dental365 has no prior deal in the target's region; its deals were Multi-Regional, National and Midwest [T:record, K:by_region].
risk_flags.mitigant: Geographic expansion motivated 2 of 3 deals, though the tag is common across the file [M:geographic_expansion].
risk_flags.reality: The target would be Dental365's first Southeast position, not an extension of an existing one [T:record].

risk_flags.title: Unconfirmed capacity
risk_flags.concern: Dental365's revenue was not researched, so funding an $80M deal cannot be assessed [V:synergy, X:target].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its largest deal was $73M and its median paid of 14.5x is within the comparable range [T:record, V:comps].
risk_flags.reality: Synergy headroom of $5M-$9M helps, but financing capacity remains open [V:synergy].

conviction.rationale: Three Dental365 deals in the target's own sub-sector and none in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the fit, but no deal in the target's region leaves that factor neutral [C:conviction].
